page_title: UNI 2-1 HOF | Union Berlin v Hoffenheim 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
90+2' The ball goes behind for a corner. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Alexander Prass is replaced by Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim).
89' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
85' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
85' The resulting corner from Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) is cleared.
85' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) serves up a nice cross, but Oliver Baumann punches the ball away.
84' That's the end of the game for Tom Bischof, who is replaced by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim).
82' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) commits a rough foul. Matthias Jollenbeck stops the game and makes a call.
81' The corner by Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
79' Matthias Jollenbeck shows the yellow card to Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) for a heavy challenge.
76' Bo Svensson is forced to make a change. Tom Rothe is unable to continue due to injury, Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) comes on.
75' The attendance for today's match is 21831.
73' A cross from a corner kick by Hoffenheim is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
73' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
71' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) has tested the patience of referee Matthias Jollenbeck and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
70' Woo-Yeong Jeong will be replaced by Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin).
70' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Janik Haberer.
67' 2 - 1 Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Frederik Ronnow with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:1.
65' Bo Svensson has decided to substitute Benedict Hollerbach and he is replaced by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin).
61' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
58' Substitution. Mergim Berisha did his best and is replaced by Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim).
56' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
53' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
50' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Matthias Jollenbeck ignores the protests.
48' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) was too forceful with his tackle and Matthias Jollenbeck interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jordan Siebatcheu departs the field of play to be replaced by Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
46' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) replacing Tim Drexler.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) is coming onto the pitch as Robin Hranac cannot continue after picking up an injury.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Matthias Jollenbeck has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Union Berlin take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+1' Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) takes the direct free kick from far out, but his shot flies into the stands.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' It looks like Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) saw red with that tackle. Matthias Jollenbeck won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
44' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
44' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
43' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) takes the corner with a short pass.

43' A neat pass finds Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the bottom left corner, but Frederik Ronnow denies him with a good save.
42' A cross from Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
38' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 10:0.
35' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
32' Dangerous play by Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim). Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
29' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
24' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
23' The foul by Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Matthias Jollenbeck.
23' A corner kick by Union Berlin is thwarted by the well prepared Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim).
22' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
21' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin).
20' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Union Berlin have been awarded a free kick.
17' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
15' Matthias Jollenbeck interrupts the game. One of the players from Union Berlin won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
13' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Hoffenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
9' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
6' 2 - 0 Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball inside the left post.
4' 1 - 0 Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) is the first to get to a rebound inside the penalty area and his weak, but precise effort finds its way into the back of the net, bouncing in off the crossbar.
4' It will be a corner kick for Union Berlin.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Hoffenheim will kick the game off.
Matthias Jollenbeck will supervise the game today.
